about: The record documents peripheral artery disease at L001. The care review at L046 rules out both published exceptions. No statin was supplied.
Possible finding with regular clopidogrel and no recent statin. The record lacks Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, Established moderate or severe physical frailty and End-of-life status.
Peripheral artery disease is documented and the only statin supply is outside the last six months, but the lipid clinic records intolerance to all suitable statins.
